question: Who is the Chief Justice of India as on March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NV Ramana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **NV Ramana** served as the **Chief Justice of India **as of **March 2022**.
 
• He was appointed as the **48th Chief Justice of India** on April 24, 2021.
 
• Justice NV Ramana has played a significant role in several landmark judgments and has been an advocat
